abstract: The development of hydrogen refueling stations (HRSs) and hydrogen fuel cell vehicles (HFCVs) is highly interdependent. This creates a coordination dilemma: an insufficient HRS network constrains HFCV adoption, while limited HFCV deployment in turn undermines the economic viability of HRSs. Local governments have implemented subsidy policies to mitigate this dilemma. However, subsidy intensities vary substantially across cities. To assess subsidy effectiveness, this study constructs a system dynamics model. Under different subsidy scenarios, the model simulates the evolution of HRSs and HFCVs and evaluates the economic viability of HRSs. Five major cities in Shandong Province, China, are selected as the case study. The results show that, compared with the business-as-usual scenario, increasing subsidy intensities does not necessarily improve the economic viability of HRSs and promote the growth of HFCVs and HRSs, suggesting the need for coordinated subsidy intensity portfolios for each city according to regional conditions. Furthermore, cities achieve performance improvements under different scenarios, while two scenarios yield favorable outcomes for all five cities. These two scenarios increase the intensity of HRS operation and HFCV purchase subsidies and keep the HRS construction subsidy at the baseline level, differing in whether the hydrogen production R&D subsidy intensity is increased. The study allows an understanding of the development of HRSs and HFCVs under various subsidy scenarios and helps to provide a reference for policymakers.
abstract_zh: 加氢站（HRSs）与氢燃料电池汽车（HFCVs）的发展高度相互依存。这造成了一种协调困境：加氢站网络不足会制约氢燃料电池汽车的采用，而氢燃料电池汽车部署有限又会反过来削弱加氢站的经济可行性。地方政府已实施补贴政策以缓解这一困境。然而，各城市的补贴强度差异显著。为评估补贴有效性，本研究构建了一个系统动力学模型。在不同补贴情景下，该模型模拟加氢站与氢燃料电池汽车的演化，并评估加氢站的经济可行性。研究选取中国山东省五个主要城市作为案例。结果表明，与一切照旧情景相比，提高补贴强度并不必然改善加氢站的经济可行性并促进氢燃料电池汽车和加氢站的增长，这表明需要根据区域条件为各城市制定协调的补贴强度组合。此外，各城市在不同情景下均实现了绩效改善，而有两种情景对全部五个城市均产生了有利结果。这两种情景提高了加氢站运营补贴和氢燃料电池汽车购置补贴强度，并将加氢站建设补贴保持在基准水平，其区别在于是否提高制氢研发补贴强度。该研究有助于理解各种补贴情景下加氢站与氢燃料电池汽车的发展，并有助于为政策制定者提供参考。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要仅出现一次中国相关表述，需确认中国是否为核心研究对象
title: Impact of subsidy policies on the development of hydrogen refueling stations and hydrogen fuel cell vehicles: A multi-scenario system dynamics approach
title_zh: 补贴政策对加氢站和氢燃料电池汽车发展的影响：基于多情景系统动力学方法

abstract: This paper introduces a matrix quantile factor model for matrix-valued data with low-rank structure. We estimate the row and column factor spaces via minimizing the empirical check loss function with orthogonal rotation constraints. We show that the estimates converge at rate (min{p1p2,p2T,p1T})−1/2 in the average Frobenius norm, where p1, p2 and T are the row dimensionality, column dimensionality and length of the matrix sequence, respectively. This rate is faster than that of the quantile estimates via “flattening" the matrix model into a large vector model. To establish the central limit theorem, we introduce a tricky augmented Lagrangian function, which is equivalent to the original constrained empirical check loss minimization problem. Via the equivalence, we prove that the Hessian matrix of the augmented Lagrangian function is locally positive definite, resulting in a locally convex penalized loss function around the true factors and their loadings. This easily leads to a feasible second-order expansion of the score function and readily established central limit theorems of the smoothed estimates of the loadings. We provide three consistent criteria to determine the pair of row and column factor numbers. Extensive simulation studies and an empirical study justify our theory.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种适用于具有低秩结构的矩阵值数据的矩阵分位数因子模型。我们通过最小化带有正交旋转约束的经验检查损失函数来估计行与列因子空间。研究表明，在平均Frobenius范数下，估计值的收敛速度为(min{p1p2,p2T,p1T})−1/2，其中p1、p2和T分别代表矩阵序列的行维度、列维度和长度。这一速度优于将矩阵模型“扁平化”为大型向量模型后的分位数估计速度。为建立中心极限定理，我们引入了一个巧妙的增广拉格朗日函数，该函数与原始带约束的经验检查损失最小化问题等价。通过这种等价性，我们证明了增广拉格朗日函数的Hessian矩阵在局部是正定的，从而在真实因子及其载荷周围产生一个局部凸的惩罚损失函数。这便于得到得分函数的可行二阶展开，并顺利建立载荷平滑估计的中心极限定理。我们提供了三种一致准则来确定行与列因子数的配对。广泛的模拟研究和一项实证研究验证了我们的理论。
title: Matrix Quantile Factor Model
title_zh: 矩阵分位数因子模型

abstract: Payroll data from Great Britain reveal that men are paid more than women upon entry into firms. Although this hiring wage gap has narrowed over the past two decades, it still accounts for over two‐thirds of the steady‐state gender pay gap—the wage gap that would eventually prevail under constant employment levels. A significant part of this hiring wage gap is not explained by men and women working in different firms and occupations. Even when hiring men and women into the same job, there remains an unexplained hiring wage gap that favors men by 2.4 log points.
abstract_zh: 英国薪资数据显示，男性在进入企业时获得的薪酬高于女性。尽管这一入职薪资差距在过去二十年中有所缩小，但它仍占稳态性别薪资差距——即在就业水平恒定时最终会存在的薪资差距——的三分之二以上。这一入职薪资差距的显著部分无法由男性和女性在不同企业和职业中工作来解释。即使在招聘男性和女性进入同一岗位时，仍存在一个无法解释的入职薪资差距，偏向男性2.4个对数点。
title: Unequal hiring wages and their impact on the gender pay gap
title_zh: 不平等的招聘工资及其对性别薪酬差距的影响

abstract: Annuities, long‐term care insurance, and reverse mortgages remain puzzlingly unpopular to manage post‐retirement longevity, health, and housing price risks. We use a flexible life‐cycle model structurally estimated with a unique stated‐preference survey experiment of Canadian households to understand why. Key factors include high risk aversion, concern over long‐run risks, strong discounting of valuation in disability states, imperfect housing substitutability, and bequest motives. The remaining disinterest is accounted for by information frictions and inertia. We also document evidence of public insurance crowding out, spousal co‐insurance, and responsiveness to product bundling.
abstract_zh: 年金、长期护理保险和反向抵押贷款在管理退休后长寿、健康及房价风险方面仍出人意料地不受欢迎。我们利用一个灵活的生命周期模型，该模型通过针对加拿大家庭的独特陈述偏好调查实验进行结构估计，以理解其原因。关键因素包括高风险厌恶、对长期风险的担忧、对残疾状态下价值评估的强烈折现、住房替代的不完全性以及遗赠动机。剩余的不感兴趣则归因于信息摩擦和惯性。我们还记录了公共保险挤出效应、配偶共同保险以及对产品捆绑销售的响应性证据。
title: Longevity, Health, and Housing Risk Management in Retirement
title_zh: 退休中的长寿、健康与住房风险管理

abstract: Recent food price inflation has placed substantial pressure on household budgets, food security, and mental well‐being. Using Household Pulse Survey data, we combine k‐modes clustering and Double Machine Learning to identify distinct household coping groups and examine differences in how households respond to rising food prices across groups. Results show that higher food prices are associated with increased grocery and prepared meal spending, elevate risks of food insufficiency, and worsen mental health conditions, with heterogeneity across coping groups. Households employing moderate substitution strategies show limited buffering, while those using more intensive coping behaviors remain highly vulnerable, highlighting the need for policy responses that address the multiple, co‐occurring dimensions of hardship including food access, financial strain, and mental health, rather than any single dimension in isolation.
abstract_zh: 近期食品价格通胀对家庭预算、食品安全和心理健康造成了巨大压力。利用家庭脉搏调查数据，我们结合k-modes聚类和双机器学习方法，识别出不同的家庭应对群体，并考察各群体在面对食品价格上涨时应对方式的差异。结果显示，食品价格上涨与杂货和预制餐支出的增加相关，提升了食品不足的风险，并加剧了心理健康问题，且不同应对群体之间存在异质性。采用适度替代策略的家庭缓冲效果有限，而采用更密集应对行为的家庭仍高度脆弱，这凸显了政策应对需针对多重、并发发生的困境维度——包括食品获取、经济压力和心理健康——而非孤立地处理任何单一维度。
title: Behavioral Coping With Food Price Inflation: Patterns Among U.S. Households
title_zh: 美国居民家庭应对食品价格通胀的行为策略模式

abstract: Are banks safer when they hold more safe assets? This paper builds a model in which banks supply liquidity services through uninsured deposits. Define a safe asset as an asset with both low payoff risk and high pledgeability. Banks consider equity costly and because of safe assets’ low payoff risk prefer to fund them largely with deposits. High pledgeability makes this feasible. The rise in banks’ deposit supply increases deposit rates and forces banks to deviate from socially desirable levels of capital to meet return-on-equity targets. Regulatory leverage ratios can be tightened to increase welfare.
abstract_zh: 银行持有更多安全资产时是否更安全？本文构建了一个模型，其中银行通过未保险存款提供流动性服务。将安全资产定义为既具有低支付风险又具有高可质押性的资产。银行视股权成本高昂，并因安全资产的低支付风险而倾向于大量以存款为其融资。高可质押性使这一做法成为可能。银行存款供给的增加推高了存款利率，迫使银行偏离社会合意的资本水平以满足股本回报率目标。监管杠杆比率可被收紧以提升社会福利。
title: Macroprudential regulation and banks’ supply of liquidity services
title_zh: 宏观审慎监管与银行流动性服务供给

abstract: In the context of a rapidly ageing population, the escalating costs of elderly care pose significant challenges for households in allocating investment assets, thereby impeding optimal asset distribution. Drawing on data from the China Household Finance Survey (CHFS) spanning 2011 to 2019, this study takes the pilot of the long-term care insurance policy (LTCI policy) as a quasi-natural experiment to empirically examine how it reshapes Chinese household financial asset allocation. The findings indicate that the LTCI policy increases the share of investment assets held by households by 2.50 percentage points. The main findings remain robust to a series of robustness checks, including the Sun-Abraham event-study approach and the de Chaisemartin and D’Haultfœuille framework for addressing treatment-effect heterogeneity. Policy beneficiary analyses reveal that LTCI has significant effects among households in central and western China, urban households, risk-averse households, households with limited financial literacy, and households with low social capital. The results further show that LTCI is positively associated with household income and negatively associated with household debt, providing suggestive evidence consistent with potential income- and debt-related pathways.
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: The dividend of social Insurance: how long-term care insurance reshapes household asset allocation
title_zh: 社会保险的红利：长期护理保险如何重塑家庭资产配置

abstract: In a platform market where user participation is endogenous and shaped by direct network effects, we compare the competitive and welfare effects of two alternative business models: pure intermediation and ‘encroachment’ — a hybrid model where the platform competes with third-party sellers by selling its own private-label products. There are two groups of sellers: entrants, who must pay a specialization cost to access the marketplace, and incumbents, who have already paid it. With encroachment, the platform has no incentive to entirely foreclose their downstream rivals if there are positive network effects. Surprisingly, although encroachment restricts entry, it increases consumer surplus, total welfare, and the incumbents’ profit when there is a sufficiently large number of incumbents in the marketplace.
abstract_zh: 在用户参与内生且受直接网络效应影响的平台市场中，我们比较了两种替代商业模式——纯中介与“入侵”（一种平台通过销售自有品牌产品与第三方卖家竞争的混合模式）——的竞争与福利效应。市场中有两组卖家：进入者，需支付专业化成本才能进入市场；以及在位者，已支付该成本。在入侵模式下，若存在正网络效应，平台没有动机完全排挤其下游竞争对手。令人意外的是，尽管入侵限制了进入，但当市场中在位者数量足够多时，它反而提高了消费者剩余、总福利以及在位者的利润。
title: The Strategic Value of Platform Encroachment: Seller Entry and Network Effects
title_zh: 平台入侵的战略价值：卖家进入与网络效应

abstract: We develop a two-country model of trade and global pollution in which country A values environmental quality whereas country B does not. Governments choose emissions and commodity taxes non-cooperatively under autarky and free trade. Under autarky, the principle of targeting holds: country A levies a Pigouvian emissions tax, whereas neither country uses a commodity tax. Opening borders fundamentally changes the design of corrective taxation. Country A subsidizes the polluting good to shift production toward its cleaner firms. The optimal subsidy depends on the marginal social damage of emissions despite the presence of an emissions tax, implying a violation of the principle of targeting. Contrary to the conventional pollution-haven prediction, the environmentally unconcerned country need not be the exporter of the polluting good. As country A's valuation of environmental quality increases, or country B's production-cost advantage narrows, production shifts toward $A$, which eventually becomes the exporter. Beyond a critical threshold, trade reduces global emissions relative to autarky. Welfare effects are asymmetric: trade always benefits country B but may either increase or decrease welfare in country A.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个两国贸易与全球污染模型，其中A国重视环境质量，而B国不重视。在自给自足和自由贸易条件下，两国政府非合作地选择排放税和商品税。在自给自足状态下，目标原则成立：A国征收庇古式排放税，而两国均不采用商品税。开放边界从根本上改变了矫正性税收的设计。A国对污染性商品提供补贴，以将生产转向其更清洁的企业。尽管存在排放税，最优补贴仍取决于排放的边际社会损害，这违反了目标原则。与传统污染避难所预测相反，不关心环境的B国未必是污染性商品的出口国。随着A国对环境质量评价的提高，或B国生产成本优势的缩小，生产向A国转移，最终A国成为出口国。超过临界阈值后，贸易相对于自给自足降低了全球排放。福利效应不对称：贸易总是惠及B国，但可能提高或降低A国的福利。
china_relevance_reason: 论文为理论模型研究，涉及两国贸易与全球污染，未提及中国数据、制度或政策背景，与中国研究无直接关联。
title: Differing environmental preferences, fiscal competition, and taxation of goods and pollution
title_zh: 环境偏好差异、财政竞争与商品及污染税收

abstract: We present a model showing that when the demand for labor services is inelastic and individual behavior is imperfectly monitored, a firm's employees may prefer to protect its shirkers and conceal information about peers' performance from the firm.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，表明当劳动服务需求缺乏弹性且个体行为受到不完全监督时，企业的员工可能倾向于保护其偷懒者，并向企业隐瞒关于同事绩效的信息。
title: Labor Associations: The Blue Wall of Silence
title_zh: 劳工协会：沉默的蓝墙

abstract: Existing theories explain how exit disciplines governments but generally treat citizens’ ability to relocate as an institutional primitive. This paper instead endogenizes exit protection by modeling jurisdictions that first choose whether to preserve or eliminate mobility before competing through extraction. Although preserving exit uniquely maximizes investment and social welfare, it is not self-enforcing because jurisdictions can profit by creating captive populations. Exit protection is therefore institutionally fragile. The paper then evaluates alternative constitutional architectures capable of addressing this incentive problem and develops one formally. The analysis identifies a benchmark constitutional architecture under which decentralized political orders could, in principle, sustain exit without relying on hierarchical enforcement, repeated interaction, or citizen coercive power.
abstract_zh: 现有理论解释了退出机制如何约束政府，但通常将公民的迁移能力视为制度上的既定前提。本文则将退出保护内生化，通过构建模型，探讨辖区在通过征收进行竞争之前，首先选择是保留还是消除流动性。尽管保留退出机制在最大化投资和社会福利方面具有唯一优势，但它并非自我实施，因为辖区可以通过制造受困人口来获利。因此，退出保护在制度上是脆弱的。本文随后评估了能够应对这一激励问题的替代性宪法架构，并正式发展出一种架构。分析识别出一种基准宪法架构，在此架构下，分散的政治秩序原则上能够在不依赖层级执行、重复互动或公民强制力量的情况下维持退出机制。
title: The political economy of exit protection
title_zh: 退出保护的政治经济学

abstract: Populist parties have grown rapidly in popularity in many European countries and have increasingly become common in government coalitions. Because these parties often make expansive promises and derive much of their appeal from their outsider status, entering government may become an electoral liability by the next election. Analyzing populist and mainstream parties in 32 European countries from 1980 to 2023, we estimate the average electoral effect of government participation. We find a post-power penalty of about 4.5–5 percentage points on average. This penalty is remarkably similar for populist and mainstream parties, suggesting that populist parties do not suffer an additional electoral cost from governing. Moreover, the size of the post-power penalty does not vary systematically with growth, inequality, social spending, globalization, or unemployment during the governing term. These findings suggest that bringing populist parties into government does not, by itself, impose a distinctive electoral cost on them relative to other incumbent parties.
abstract_zh: 民粹主义政党在许多欧洲国家的支持率迅速上升，并日益成为政府联盟中的常见成员。由于这些政党往往做出宏大的承诺，并主要依靠其局外人身份吸引选民，进入政府可能会在下次选举中成为其选举上的不利因素。通过分析1980年至2023年间32个欧洲国家的民粹主义政党与主流政党，我们估计了政府参与的平均选举效应。研究发现，执政后平均存在约4.5至5个百分点的惩罚效应。这一惩罚对民粹主义政党与主流政党而言惊人地相似，表明民粹主义政党并未因执政而承担额外的选举成本。此外，执政期间的增长、不平等、社会支出、全球化或失业率并未系统性地改变执政后惩罚的大小。这些发现表明，将民粹主义政党纳入政府本身，并不会相对于其他执政党对其施加独特的选举成本。
title: A hangover like any other: the cost of ruling for populist parties
title_zh: 宿醉如常：民粹主义政党的执政代价

abstract: Focus We explore the intraday timing of transactions in Colombia's large-value payment system from 2018 to 2025. We focus on how changes in reserve requirements affect liquidity management by financial institutions. Using high-frequency transaction data, we examine how reductions to reserve requirements, alongside liquidity conditions and institutional developments, shape the timing and distribution of settlements in the payment system.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了2018年至2025年间哥伦比亚大额支付系统中交易的日内时间安排。我们重点关注准备金要求的变化如何影响金融机构的流动性管理。利用高频交易数据，我们考察了准备金要求的降低，连同流动性状况和制度发展，如何塑造支付系统中结算的时间安排与分布。
title: Settlement liquidity in the Colombian large-value payment system: the role of reserve requirements
title_zh: 哥伦比亚大额支付系统中的结算流动性：准备金要求的作用

abstract: We develop a general-equilibrium model of the global economy that integrates heterogeneous firms competing in product markets with countries that allocate capital around the world. Combining a hedonic demand system on the product side with a mean-variance portfolio system on the asset side, we obtain almost closed-form solutions for the equilibrium of the model. We use firm-level data on balance sheets, geographic breakdowns of revenue and employment, and business descriptions along with country-level data on bilateral equity holdings and trade costs to quantify the model to a cross section of roughly 23,000 listed firms in 48 countries. We use the model to evaluate the reallocation and welfare effects of globalization. Both financial and trade liberalization concentrate activity among the largest firms and raise welfare, with gains being larger in emerging and mid-sized open economies respectively. Product- and capital-market frictions amplify each other, meaning that liberalizing one market reduces the gains from liberalizing the other.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个全球经济的总体均衡模型，该模型将产品市场中竞争的异质性企业与在全球范围内配置资本的国家相结合。通过在产品侧结合享乐需求系统，在资产侧结合均值-方差投资组合系统，我们得到了模型均衡的近似闭式解。我们利用企业层面的资产负债表数据、收入和就业的地理分布、业务描述，以及国家层面的双边股权持有和贸易成本数据，将模型量化应用于48个国家约23,000家上市公司的横截面数据。我们运用该模型评估全球化带来的重新配置和福利效应。金融和贸易自由化均使活动集中于规模最大的企业，并提升福利，其中新兴经济体和中型开放经济体分别获得更大的收益。产品市场和资本市场的摩擦相互放大，意味着对其中一个市场的自由化会减少另一个市场自由化带来的收益。
title: A Model of Global Firms and Capital Markets
title_zh: 全球企业与资本市场模型

abstract: Consensus professional stock return forecasts are three times more volatile than those of non-professionals and econometricians. We show that this difference reflects professionals’ strong countercyclical responses to macro shocks, which explain 20–40% of forecast variation and are consistent with rational asset pricing models in which discount rates rise in bad times. We use macro shocks to identify the discount-rate component of professional forecasts and find that it closely matches realized returns. We conclude that professionals’ assessment of the discount-rate impact of macro shocks distinguishes them from other forecasts, challenging existing models of expectation formation.
abstract_zh: 共识性专业股票收益预测的波动性是非专业人士和计量经济学家的三倍。我们表明，这一差异反映了专业人士对宏观冲击的强烈逆周期反应，这些反应解释了预测变异的20%-40%，并与理性资产定价模型一致，即折现率在经济不景气时上升。我们利用宏观冲击来识别专业预测中的折现率成分，并发现其与实际回报紧密匹配。我们得出结论，专业人士对宏观冲击折现率影响的评估使其区别于其他预测，这对现有的预期形成模型提出了挑战。
title: What drives the volatility of professional stock return forecasts? Causal evidence from macro shocks
title_zh: 宏观经济冲击对专业股票收益预测波动性的因果影响

abstract: Against the backdrop of economic globalization, relationships among countries established through regional services trade agreements (services RTAs) have become increasingly complex. Assessing a country’s global value chain (GVC) position requires considering its place within the network of services RTAs formed with other economies. Using data from 60 countries for the period 2007–2021, this study estimates the impact of the services RTA network, with network linkages weighted by agreement depth, on countries’ GVC positions. The results indicate that the expansion and deepening of the services RTA network significantly promote the upgrading of countries’ GVC positions, and the conclusion is robust. This positive effect operates primarily through three channels: reductions in services trade costs, technology spillovers, and adjustments to production length. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that the positive effect of the services RTA network on GVC upgrading is more pronounced in North-North and North-South cooperation as well as in multilateral agreements, and that this effect varies across sectors. This study contributes to understanding how the services RTA network affects the development of global value chains and provides insights for countries seeking to improve their services trade policies. KEYWORDS: Regional services trade agreements GVC upgrading complex network analysis deep RTAs intensive margin JEL CLASSIFICATION: F13 F14 F60
abstract_zh: 在经济全球化的背景下，各国通过区域服务贸易协定（服务RTA）建立的国家间关系日益复杂。评估一个国家的全球价值链（GVC）地位，需要考虑其与其他经济体形成的服务RTA网络中的位置。本研究利用2007年至2021年间60个国家的数据，估计了以协定深度加权的服务RTA网络联系对国家GVC地位的影响。结果表明，服务RTA网络的扩展与深化显著促进了国家GVC地位的提升，且该结论具有稳健性。这一积极效应主要通过三个渠道发挥作用：服务贸易成本的降低、技术溢出以及生产长度的调整。异质性分析揭示，服务RTA网络对GVC升级的积极效应在南北合作和北北合作以及多边协定中更为显著，且该效应在不同部门间存在差异。本研究有助于理解服务RTA网络如何影响全球价值链的发展，并为各国改善服务贸易政策提供了启示。关键词：区域服务贸易协定；GVC升级；复杂网络分析；深度RTA；集约边际 JEL分类：F13 F14 F60
title: Regional services trade agreements and upgrading in global value chains: an analysis from the network perspective
title_zh: 区域服务贸易协定与全球价值链升级：基于网络视角的分析

abstract: As data evolve into a core factor of production in the digital economy, their assetization poses unprecedented challenges to financial reporting and auditing practices. Based on a sample of Chinese A-share listed firms in Shanghai and Shenzhen from 2013 to 2024, this study empirically examines the impact of corporate data assetization on audit pricing and its underlying mechanisms. The results show that data assetization significantly increases audit fees, a finding robust to a series of tests. Mechanism analysis reveals three distinct channels: higher audit resource input, greater difficulty in measuring excess goodwill, and elevated operational risk. Further analysis shows that the upward pressure on audit fees is more pronounced among non-state-owned enterprises, technology-intensive firms, and firms with aggressive earnings management, poor ESG performance, or negative textual tone in annual reports. Additional evidence confirms that data assetization increases auditors’ propensity to issue modified audit opinions. This study extends audit pricing research to data assets by demonstrating how their unique attributes reshape audit risk and resource allocation. It also offers practical implications for corporate governance, auditor expertise, and regulatory standard-setting. KEYWORDS: Data assetization audit fees audit risk audit opinions JEL CLASSIFICATION: M42 O33 G32 G41
abstract_zh: 随着数据演变为数字经济中的核心生产要素，其资产化对财务报告与审计实务构成了前所未有的挑战。本研究以2013年至2024年中国沪深A股上市公司为样本，实证考察了企业数据资产化对审计定价的影响及其内在机制。结果表明，数据资产化显著提高了审计费用，该发现在一系列检验中保持稳健。机制分析揭示了三条不同的传导渠道：审计资源投入增加、超额商誉计量难度加大以及经营风险上升。进一步分析显示，审计费用的上行压力在非国有企业、技术密集型企业以及具有激进盈余管理、ESG表现不佳或年报文本语调负面的企业中更为显著。额外证据证实，数据资产化提高了审计师出具非标准审计意见的倾向。本研究将审计定价研究拓展至数据资产领域，展示了其独特属性如何重塑审计风险与资源配置，同时为企业治理、审计师专业能力及监管标准制定提供了实践启示。关键词：数据资产化；审计费用；审计风险；审计意见 JEL分类：M42 O33 G32 G41
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Data assetization and audit pricing: evidence from China’s digital economy
title_zh: 数据资产化与审计定价：来自中国数字经济的证据

abstract: We draw on evidence from the 2026 Iran War to assess the validity of estimates of the short-run price elasticity of oil supply reported in the literature. Our analysis confirms that the one-month and one-quarter U.S. oil supply elasticity is effectively zero, consistent with estimates in Newell and Prest (2019). The data strongly reject the much higher elasticity estimates reported by more recent studies. This finding is consistent with evidence from surveys of oil company executives and with industry data about how long it takes to complete a well and start pumping oil. It is also consistent with theoretical arguments that the short-run oil supply elasticity is zero if adjusting oil production is costly, as is the case in practice. Our results have important implications for the construction and credibility of structural VAR models of the global oil market.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2026年伊朗战争的证据，评估文献中报告的石油供给短期价格弹性估计的有效性。我们的分析证实，美国石油供给的一个月和一季度弹性实际上为零，这与纽厄尔和普雷斯特（2019）的估计一致。数据强烈否定了近期研究报告的更高弹性估计。这一发现与对石油公司高管的调查证据以及关于完成一口井并开始抽油所需时间的行业数据相符。同时，它也支持理论论点，即如果调整石油生产是有成本的（实际情况正是如此），那么短期石油供给弹性为零。我们的结果对全球石油市场结构性VAR模型的构建和可信度具有重要意义。
title: What the Iran War Teaches Us about the Price Elasticity of Oil Supply
title_zh: 伊朗战争对石油供给价格弹性的启示

abstract: We present a model of competition between environmental, social, and governance (ESG) raters who acquire information about multiple unrelated categories and sell ratings. Raters specializing in different categories maximize the amount of information transmitted and surplus, and can be an equilibrium outcome. When investors place a high value on ESG performance across multiple categories, the unique equilibrium is for the raters to generalize—splitting their effort among the categories, resulting in less informative ratings. Greenwashing by firms can make generalization the only equilibrium. We also demonstrate that specialization maximizes ratings disagreement, and thus empirical measures of disagreement may be poor measures of surplus.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，探讨环境、社会和治理（ESG）评级机构之间的竞争，这些机构获取关于多个不相关类别的信息并出售评级。专注于不同类别的评级机构能最大化信息传递量和剩余价值，这可以成为均衡结果。当投资者高度重视跨多个类别的ESG表现时，唯一均衡是评级机构采取泛化策略——将努力分散到各个类别，导致评级信息含量降低。企业的漂绿行为可能使泛化成为唯一均衡。我们还证明，专业化能最大化评级分歧，因此实证中的分歧指标可能无法有效衡量剩余价值。
title: The Market for ESG Ratings
title_zh: ESG评级市场

abstract: We consider a three-sided market where each buyer-seller pair can attain a profit only if there is a middleman that connects them. This profit does not depend on the identity of the middlemen, and each buyer and seller can take part in at most one partnership while middlemen can establish multiple partnerships, up to their capacity. We show that the core is non-empty and strictly contains the set of competitive equilibrium payoff vectors that coincides with the set of solutions of the dual q -assignment problem, where q is the total capacity of the middlemen.
abstract_zh: 我们考察一个三边市场，其中每对买卖双方只有在存在中间人连接时才能获得利润。该利润不依赖于中间人的身份，且每位买方和卖方最多只能参与一项合作关系，而中间人则可建立多项合作关系，直至其容量上限。我们证明，核心非空，并严格包含竞争均衡支付向量集合，该集合与对偶q-分配问题的解集一致，其中q为中间人的总容量。
title: Assignment markets with capacitated middlemen: core and competitive equilibria
title_zh: 具有容量限制中间人的指派市场：核与竞争均衡

abstract: This paper considers a natural ruleset for playing a partisan combinatorial game on a directed graph, which we call Digraph placement. Given a digraph G with a not necessarily proper 2-coloring of V(G), the Digraph placement game played on G by the players Left and Right, who play alternately, is defined as follows. On her turn, Left chooses a blue vertex which is deleted along with all of its out-neighbours. On his turn Right chooses a red vertex, which is deleted along with all of its out-neighbours. A player loses if on their turn they cannot move. We show constructively that Digraph placement is a universal partisan ruleset; for all partisan combinatorial games X there exists a Digraph placement game, G, such that $$G = X$$ . Digraph placement and many other games including Nim, Poset Games, Col, Node Kayles, Domineering, and Arc Kayles are instances of a class of placement games that we call conflict placement games. We prove that X is a conflict placement game if and only if it has the same literal form as a Digraph placement game. A corollary of this is that deciding the winner of a Digraph placement game is PSPACE-hard. Next, for a game value X we prove bounds on the order of a smallest Digraph placement game G such that $$G = X$$ .
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种在有向图上进行党派组合博弈的自然规则集，我们称之为有向图放置（Digraph placement）。给定一个有向图G，其顶点集V(G)具有一个不一定正常的2-着色，由玩家Left和Right交替进行的Digraph放置博弈定义如下：轮到Left时，她选择一个蓝色顶点，该顶点连同其所有出邻点一起被删除；轮到Right时，他选择一个红色顶点，该顶点连同其所有出邻点一起被删除。若某玩家在其回合无法行动，则该玩家输掉游戏。我们构造性地证明，Digraph放置是一个通用的党派规则集；对于所有党派组合博弈X，存在一个Digraph放置博弈G，使得$$G = X$$。Digraph放置以及包括Nim、偏序集博弈、Col、Node Kayles、Domineering和Arc Kayles在内的许多其他博弈，都是我们称为冲突放置博弈的一类放置博弈的实例。我们证明，X是冲突放置博弈当且仅当它与某个Digraph放置博弈具有相同的字面形式。由此推论，判定Digraph放置博弈的胜者问题是PSPACE-hard的。接下来，对于博弈值X，我们证明了使得$$G = X$$的最小Digraph放置博弈G的阶数的界。
title: Digraph placement games
title_zh: 有向图放置博弈

abstract: How does higher productivity affect inflation? Productivity shifts both supply and demand (through real incomes), and its effect on inflation depends on their relative magnitude and timing, and on how monetary policy responds. We distinguish between a one-off level shock that temporarily increases productivity above trend and a persistent increase in productivity growth. A one-off shock lowers marginal costs and lifts potential output, generating downward pressure on the price level. However, this is a level effect and once prices adjust, inflation returns to target. In contrast, higher productivity growth raises expected permanent income, which stimulates investment and consumption, pushing up on the natural real rate. Absent a tightening of monetary policy, this can generate inflationary pressures. Anticipation effects are central: if demand rises ahead of realised productivity gains, inflation can rise even as productive capacity expands. In an open economy, the impact on inflation also depends on whether productivity gains occur in the tradable or the non-tradable sector. In summary, the inflationary consequences of higher productivity are a priori ambiguous and depend on the balance and timing of demand and supply responses, the composition of consumption across tradables and non-tradables, and importantly, the monetary policy response.
abstract_zh: 更高的生产率如何影响通货膨胀？生产率同时影响供给与需求（通过实际收入），其对通胀的影响取决于两者的相对规模与时机，以及货币政策如何应对。我们区分一次性水平冲击（使生产率暂时高于趋势）与生产率增长的持续性提升。一次性冲击降低边际成本并提升潜在产出，对价格水平产生下行压力。然而，这是一种水平效应，一旦价格调整完毕，通胀将回归目标水平。相比之下，生产率增长加快会提高预期永久收入，从而刺激投资与消费，推高自然实际利率。若缺乏货币政策的收紧，这可能引发通胀压力。预期效应至关重要：若需求在生产率实际提升之前先行上升，即使生产能力扩张，通胀也可能上升。在开放经济中，通胀影响还取决于生产率提升发生在可贸易部门还是不可贸易部门。总之，更高生产率对通胀的影响在理论上具有不确定性，取决于需求与供给反应的平衡与时机、可贸易品与不可贸易品消费的构成，以及尤为重要的货币政策应对。
title: Productivity and Inflation Dynamics
title_zh: 生产率与通货膨胀动态

abstract: We introduce the notion of marginal cumulative multiplier — the effect of either government spending or taxation on output holding the other fiscal instrument constant - and apply it to a well known panel of consolidation episodes in 16 countries in the period 1978-2020. In our benchmark specification we estimate a marginal spending multiplier at two years of 1.5 and a marginal tax multiplier close to 0. We also estimate similar multipliers by applying the policy counterfactual method of McKay and Wolf (2023). In an extensive robustness analysis we never find spending multipliers below 1.3 or tax multipliers higher than -1. These findings are seemingly in contrast to those of much of the existing literature on fiscal multipliers, which typically finds higher tax than spending multipliers. We show that this contradiction disappears once the fiscal variables used in the literature are scaled by the proper factor.
abstract_zh: 我们引入了边际累积乘数的概念——即在保持另一财政工具不变的情况下，政府支出或税收对产出的影响——并将其应用于一个涵盖1978年至2020年间16个国家财政整顿事件的知名面板数据集。在我们的基准设定中，估计两年期的边际支出乘数为1.5，而边际税收乘数接近于0。我们还通过应用McKay和Wolf（2023）的政策反事实方法估计了类似的乘数。在广泛的稳健性分析中，我们从未发现支出乘数低于1.3或税收乘数高于-1的情况。这些发现似乎与现有财政乘数文献中的多数结论相悖，后者通常发现税收乘数高于支出乘数。我们表明，一旦文献中使用的财政变量按适当因子进行缩放，这一矛盾便消失。
title: To Tax or To Ax? Marginal Tax and Spending Multipliers in Consolidations
title_zh: 征税还是削减？财政整顿中的边际税收与支出乘数

abstract: Post-pandemic inflation raised fears that U.S. monetary tightening would trigger a repeat of the 1982 sudden stop in capital flows to emerging economies. Yet as of 2026 no global recession has followed. We establish three stylized facts distinguishing the 1980s from the 2020s, beyond the shift to flexible exchange rates: monetary policy effectiveness, fiscal space, and external vulnerabilities. We rationalize them in a Mundell-Fleming framework with a fiscal space constraint, which predicts a central role for fiscal space in transmitting foreign currency risk-free rate increases. Cross-country evidence confirms that fiscal space shapes economic performance post-tightening.
abstract_zh: 疫情后的通胀引发了人们的担忧，即美国货币紧缩将重演1982年新兴经济体资本流入的突然停止。然而，截至2026年，全球并未出现衰退。我们确立了三个典型事实，用以区分1980年代与2020年代，除了转向浮动汇率制之外：货币政策有效性、财政空间和外部脆弱性。我们在一个包含财政空间约束的蒙代尔-弗莱明框架中对其进行了合理化解释，该框架预测财政空间在传导外币无风险利率上升中发挥核心作用。跨国证据证实，财政空间塑造了紧缩后的经济表现。
title: This Time Is (Mostly) Different: U.S. Tightening Cycles and Global Resilience in the 1980s vs 2020s
title_zh: 这一次（大体上）不同：1980年代与2020年代美国紧缩周期与全球韧性比较

abstract: We examine how policymakers’ speeches and monetary policy announcements at official policy meetings transmit to financial markets and the real economy in the euro area. Using high-frequency intraday data across a broad cross-section of financial assets, we introduce the Euro Area Extended Monetary Policy Event-Study Database (EA-EMPD). We refine the identification of monetary policy surprises by exploiting granular, quote-level data on individual market participants’ bid and ask quotes. This novel dataset expands the set of identifiable policy events by an order of magnitude relative to databases restricted to rate-setting meetings. Our analysis yields three main findings. First, central bank speeches move asset prices across all maturities by magnitudes comparable to those of official policy announcements. Second, the relative importance of surprises associated with policy decisions and speeches differs markedly between euro area and U.S. financial markets. Third, speech-induced short-rate shocks transmit to the real economy similarly to official policy shocks, and combining the two sources of policy shocks materially improves the precision of inference. Importantly, even under this much broader definition and measurement of monetary policy impulses, monetary policy shocks account for only a negligible share of fluctuations in real economic activity.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了政策制定者的演讲及官方政策会议上的货币政策公告如何传导至欧元区的金融市场与实体经济。利用涵盖广泛金融资产的高频日内数据，我们构建了欧元区扩展货币政策事件研究数据库（EA-EMPD）。通过利用个体市场参与者买卖报价的细粒度报价级数据，我们优化了货币政策冲击的识别方法。这一新颖数据集将可识别的政策事件集合相对于仅限于利率设定会议的数据库扩大了一个数量级。我们的分析得出三项主要发现。首先，央行演讲对各期限资产价格的影响幅度与官方政策公告相当。其次，与政策决策及演讲相关的冲击在欧元区与美国金融市场中的相对重要性存在显著差异。第三，演讲引发的短期利率冲击向实体经济的传导方式与官方政策冲击类似，且将两类政策冲击结合使用能显著提高推断的精确度。重要的是，即使在这种更为宽泛的货币政策冲击定义与测度下，货币政策冲击对实际经济活动波动的解释份额仍然微乎其微。
title: Monetary transmission with frequent policy events
title_zh: 频繁政策事件下的货币传导

abstract: In the context of escalating anthropogenic pressures on coastal ecosystems, this article employs a case study of one of China’s southeastern coastal mangrove reserves to interrogate the interplay between local communities and state authorities in natural resource governance from an ontological perspective. Through qualitative research involving 30 semi-structured interviews conducted between 2019 and 2023, we reveal how state, market, and community actors operate from fundamentally different – and often incompatible – understandings of mangroves. We trace a historical shift from a community ontology, where mangroves were perceived as socio-ecological commons buffering against flooding, to a market ontology through which mangroves were seen as barriers to marketized aquaculture development. While state intervention later curtailed market overexploitation, its regulatory, ecological ontology clashed with both the eroded community framework and the persistent market logic. Consequently, state governance, though justified by ecologically necessity, proved ontologically irreconcilable with the community’s original, relational approach. This study demonstrates that environmental governance conflicts are not merely about resource distribution but are rooted in conflicting ontologies and clashes between divergent world-making practices. It thus contributes a novel analytical lens for understanding governance conflicts in socio-ecological systems under competing state and market pressures, revealing that effective and just governance requires recognizing and navigating deep ontological divides, not just negotiating resource claims.
abstract_zh: 在沿海生态系统面临日益加剧的人为压力背景下，本文以中国东南沿海一处红树林保护区为案例，从本体论视角探讨自然资源治理中地方社区与国家权力之间的互动关系。通过2019年至2023年间开展的30次半结构化访谈的定性研究，我们揭示了国家、市场与社区行动者如何基于根本不同且往往互不相容的红树林理解方式运作。我们追溯了从社区本体论——红树林被视为抵御洪水的社会-生态共有资源——向市场本体论——红树林被视为市场化水产养殖发展的障碍——的历史转变。尽管国家干预后来遏制了市场的过度开发，但其监管性的生态本体论与已被侵蚀的社区框架及持续存在的市场逻辑均发生冲突。因此，国家治理虽以生态必要性为正当性依据，却在本体论上与社区原有的关系性路径无法调和。本研究表明，环境治理冲突不仅关乎资源分配，更根植于相互冲突的本体论及不同世界建构实践之间的碰撞。由此，本研究为理解国家与市场压力并存下社会-生态系统中的治理冲突提供了新的分析视角，揭示出有效且公正的治理不仅需要协商资源诉求，更需要识别并驾驭深层的本体论分歧。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: The ontological dimensions of coastal mangrove reserve conflicts——insights from China
title_zh: 中国沿海红树林保护区冲突的本体论维度——来自中国的启示

abstract: Many countries have adopted different price regulations to contain pharmaceutical prices, even in markets exposed to generic competition. This column documents subtle pricing patterns in the Swedish pharmaceutical market, where consumers get full reimbursement only by buying the cheapest product (the “product of the month”) and can only purchase their prescribed medicine in the packet size specified in their prescription. While the product-of-the-month regime substantially decreased prices and expenditure per pill initially, prices per pill are 4-5 times higher in package sizes sold by monopoly producers. These firms appear to have learned to exploit quirks of the regulation to increase their market power.
abstract_zh: 许多国家已采取不同的价格监管措施来控制药品价格，即便在面临仿制药竞争的市场中也是如此。本文记录了瑞典药品市场中微妙的定价模式，在该市场中，消费者只有购买最便宜的产品（“月度产品”）才能获得全额报销，并且只能按照处方中指定的包装规格购买所开具的药品。尽管“月度产品”制度初期显著降低了价格和每片药的支出，但在垄断生产商销售的包装规格中，每片药的价格高出4至5倍。这些企业似乎已学会利用监管中的特殊之处来增强其市场支配力。
title: Competition or collusion: Entry decisions in the Swedish pharmaceutical market
title_zh: 竞争还是合谋：瑞典药品市场的进入决策

abstract: Data show that trade sanctions reduce commerce between the countries imposing them and their targets. But this bilateral success can conceal a wider failure if the sanctions induce the target to build stronger trade links elsewhere. This column uses sector-level trade data, including domestic sales, to estimate both the bilateral trade destruction and the third-country trade creation effects together. Across 22 sectors, complete sanctions usually promote trade between targets and third countries. Russia’s 2006 embargo on Georgia illustrates this fact: additional trade to third markets more than offset the estimated 57% decline in exports to Russia.
abstract_zh: 数据显示，贸易制裁减少了实施国与目标国之间的商业往来。然而，这种双边层面的成功可能掩盖了更广泛的失败，如果制裁促使目标国在其他地方建立更紧密的贸易联系。本文利用包括国内销售在内的部门级贸易数据，同时估计了双边贸易破坏效应和第三国贸易创造效应。在22个部门中，全面制裁通常促进目标国与第三国之间的贸易。俄罗斯2006年对格鲁吉亚的禁运说明了这一事实：对第三市场增加的贸易量超过了向俄罗斯出口估计下降57%的影响。
authors: Gabriel Felbermayr, Ohyun Kwon, Constantinos Syropoulos, Yoto Yotov
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为贸易制裁的第三方效应，涉及俄罗斯对格鲁吉亚的禁运，未提及中国、中国企业或中国地区，与中国研究无直接关联。
title: When trade sanctions increase the target’s trade
title_zh: 当贸易制裁增加目标国的贸易

abstract: How does higher productivity affect inflation? Productivity shifts both supply and demand (through real incomes), and its effect on inflation depends on their relative magnitude and timing, as well as on the monetary policy response. We distinguish between a one-off level shock that increases productivity temporarily (relative to trend) and a persistent rise in productivity growth. A one-off, temporary increase in productivity lowers marginal costs and raises potential output, generating downward pressure on the price level. Once prices adjust however, inflation returns to target. By contrast, higher productivity growth raises expected permanent income and stimulates investment and consumption, increasing the natural real rate. Absent a tightening of monetary policy, inflationary pressures may emerge. Anticipation effects are central: if demand rises ahead of realised supply gains, inflation can increase despite higher productive capacity. In an open economy, the sectoral incidence of the shock also determines the impact on inflation. In summary, the inflationary consequences of productivity gains are a priori ambiguous and depend on the balance and timing of demand and supply responses, the composition of demand, and crucially, the monetary policy response.
abstract_zh: 更高的生产率如何影响通货膨胀？生产率同时影响供给与需求（通过实际收入），其对通胀的影响取决于两者的相对规模与时机，以及货币政策的应对。我们区分了暂时性（相对于趋势）提高生产率的单次水平冲击与生产率增长的持续性上升。一次性、暂时性的生产率提升会降低边际成本并提高潜在产出，对价格水平产生下行压力。然而，一旦价格调整完毕，通胀将回归目标水平。相比之下，生产率增长的提高会提升预期永久收入，刺激投资与消费，从而提高自然实际利率。若货币政策不收紧，则可能出现通胀压力。预期效应至关重要：如果需求在实现供给收益之前上升，即使生产能力增强，通胀也可能上升。在开放经济中，冲击的行业分布也决定其对通胀的影响。总之，生产率提升的通胀后果在理论上是不确定的，取决于需求与供给反应的平衡与时机、需求结构，以及关键的政策应对。
authors: Ludovica Ambrosino & Jenny Chan & Silvana Tenreyro
title: Productivity and inflation dynamics
title_zh: 生产率与通货膨胀动态

abstract: We assess impacts of a randomized deworming intervention in Kenya on the mortality of recipients’ children using 23-year longitudinal data on over 5,500 original participants and their offspring. The under-5 mortality rate fell by 23% (17 deaths per 1000 live births) for children of treatment group individuals, with larger effects when considering the in-utero period due to reduced miscarriage. A combination of improved health, education, living standards and use of health care, increased urban residence, and delayed fertility in the parent generation contributed to the reduction. The results provide evidence for meaningful intergenerational benefits of child health investments.
abstract_zh: 我们利用超过5500名原始参与者及其子女的23年纵向数据，评估了肯尼亚一项随机驱虫干预对受益者子女死亡率的影响。治疗组个体子女的5岁以下死亡率下降了23%（每千例活产减少17例死亡），若考虑宫内期因流产减少带来的效应，影响更为显著。父母一代健康状况改善、教育水平提升、生活标准提高、医疗保健利用增加、城市居住比例上升以及生育延迟等因素共同促成了这一下降。研究结果为儿童健康投资带来显著的代际收益提供了证据。
title: Intergenerational Child Mortality Impacts of Deworming: Experimental Evidence from Two Decades of the Kenya Life Panel Survey
title_zh: 驱虫治疗对代际儿童死亡率的影响：来自肯尼亚生命面板调查二十年的实验证据

abstract: We study features that supply-chains more resilient. Using new data on firm-to-firm transactions from an Indian state, we construct a firm-specific measure of upstream exposure to Covid-19 lockdowns based on pre-period purchases from affected suppliers. An event-study design shows firms with greater upstream exposure experienced higher separation rates and larger declines in real inputs and sales. However, for a given increase in upstream exposure, firms sourcing more complex inputs or inputs with fewer alternative suppliers were less likely to sever links and faced smaller production disruptions. After the shock, exposed firms adjusted, forming new links with larger, better-connected suppliers.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了使供应链更具韧性的特征。利用来自印度某邦的企业间交易新数据，我们基于疫情封锁前从受影响供应商的采购情况，构建了一个企业层面的上游疫情封锁暴露度指标。事件研究设计显示，上游暴露度较高的企业经历了更高的关系断裂率，以及实际投入和销售额的更大幅度下降。然而，在给定的上游暴露度增加下，采购更复杂投入品或替代供应商较少的投入品的企业，更不可能切断联系，且面临的生产中断较小。冲击过后，受影响企业进行了调整，与规模更大、连接更广的供应商建立了新联系。
title: Supply Chain Resilience: Evidence from Indian Firms
title_zh: 供应链韧性：来自印度企业的证据

abstract: Cesarean section rates vary widely across U.S. counties, but whether this variation reflects patients’ medical risk, beliefs, and preferences or obstetric care environments, including clinicians’ practice styles and delivery facilities, remains unclear. Using 1989–2019 U.S. birth records, we study closures of counties’ last operating obstetric units, which redirect mothers to counties with different baseline C-section rates. In an instrumental variables framework, we find that a one-percentage-point increase in the delivery county’s C-section rate raises a mother’s C-section probability by approximately one percentage point, highlighting the central role of where mothers receive obstetric care in determining C-section use.
abstract_zh: 美国各县的剖宫产率差异显著，但这种差异究竟反映的是患者的医疗风险、信念与偏好，还是产科护理环境（包括临床医生的实践风格和分娩设施）的影响，目前尚不明确。利用1989年至2019年美国出生记录，我们研究了各县最后一个运营产科单位的关闭情况，这促使产妇被转至基线剖宫产率不同的县。在工具变量框架下，我们发现，分娩所在县的剖宫产率每提高一个百分点，产妇接受剖宫产的概率约增加一个百分点，这凸显了产妇接受产科护理的地点对剖宫产使用所起的核心决定作用。
title: Disentangling Sources of Variation in C-Section Rates
title_zh: 剖宫产率变异来源的分解
